title: Photography: Intro
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose photographs for the sensory detail they communicate. A visible glisten or stretch can give the viewer a reason to imagine eating the food.
strategic_value: Instacart can make photography carry appetite in communications that also have to do the practical work of selling groceries.
demonstration: A large multiline statement gives examples of food textures. A smaller orange note identifies some images as reference material and calls for studio approval before use.
practical_value: Use a concrete texture or food action in an image brief. Check the status of a reference photograph before including it in published work.
